title: Finite-stage representative of the common pullback tensor comparison
statement: For a prime l, an algebraically closed coefficient field Ω, a scheme morphism f : X ⟶ Y, and common-stage objects P and Q over Y, the canonical common pullback/tensor comparison is represented at every finite coefficient stage L above the tensor stage by ofHom applied to pullbackTensorAtCommonStage.

proof.text: Unfold canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor as pullbackTensorUniqueChoice applied to canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor_existsUnique. Apply the representative clause of the exists-unique witness at L and h.
